Job Title: Angular Developer
Experience: 1-3 years
Location: Fully remote within India.
Mandatory Skills:
- Angular
- Jest or Sass

Good to have:
- NgRx
- CSS
- HTML

Responsibilities:
- Join a small, fast-moving frontend team building a B2B SaaS dashboard used by enterprise customers. Implement new UI features and translate designs into responsive, accessible Angular components.
- Own feature development from requirements through testing and deployment, writing unit tests using Jest (if chosen) or styling components using Sass as applicable.
- Collaborate with product managers and backend engineers to integrate REST/GraphQL APIs and ensure end-to-end quality.
- Contribute to component libraries, enforce consistent styling and best practices, and help improve build and CI processes.
- Debug and profile frontend performance issues, and propose pragmatic optimizations.
- Participate in code reviews, mentor junior developers, and document implementation details and patterns.
